content.query:
select 
    fulldate, 
    business_day_flag, 
    Weekday, 
    WeekDayName 
from eds.date_dim 
where 
    WeekDayName in ('Saturday','Sunday') and
    fulldate>=cast('2024-07-20' as date) 
order by fulldate

With latest_pdate as (select dateadd(dd,1,max(process_Date)) fulldate
from 
om.om_task_run where task_name='TSK_EDS_DEP_DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD' AND STATUS_ID=3)
select 
    latest_pdate.fulldate
from 
latest_pdate
inner join eds.date_dim
    on latest_pdate.fulldate = date_dim.fulldate
    and WeekDayName in ('Saturday','Sunday')
